name: Ishmael
bio: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, a royal descendant and military officer, came to Gedaliah at Mizpah with ten men and assassinated him, along with the Jews and Chaldean soldiers present, despite having been warned of his treachery. He then massacred eighty mourners who came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, dumping their bodies in a cistern, and carried off the people of Mizpah toward Ammon. Johanan son of Kareah pursued and intercepted him at Gibeon, freeing the captives, though Ishmael himself escaped with eight men to the Ammonites (Jeremiah 40:13-41:15).
